content.title: Arsenal Goalkeeper David Raya Set to Have Scan on Shoulder Injury
content.caption: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya is set to have a scan on his shoulder after going off injured during Saturday's 2-2 draw with Newcastle.

slides.heading: Arsenal Goalkeeper David Raya Set to Have Scan on Shoulder
slides.text: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya is set to have a scan on his shoulder after going off injured during Saturday's 2-2 draw with Newcastle.

slides.heading: What Happened
slides.text: David Raya, Arsenal's first-choice goalkeeper, was forced to leave the pitch 70 minutes into Saturday's 2-2 draw with Newcastle, appearing to hurt his shoulder in an innocuous challenge with Magpies forward William Osula.

slides.heading: Why Does It Matter
slides.text: Arsenal is about to enter a gruelling period of games with or without Raya, facing Borussia Dortmund, Manchester City, Brentford, Tottenham Hotspur, and Real Madrid in the next four weeks.
